selected_t16_target.title: Standards Denormalized Field Fidelity Verification
selected_t16_target.objective: Add a validator check that independently re-derives the expected organization/designation/edition/title/verification_state for every projected standard reference directly from its knowledge-layer record and compares it to the projection's actual denormalized values.
selected_t16_target.root_risk: buildStandardsBlock() in generate-tapping-projections.js denormalizes 5 fields from the resolved standard record at generation time; nothing re-verifies this against the source after the fact. A hand-edit to tapping-profiles.json, a future generator refactor pulling the wrong field, or data corruption could substitute a wrong-but-plausible designation/title/edition for a still-validly-referenced standard_id, and every existing validator (including check 2's ID-existence check) would still pass.
selected_t16_target.source_of_truth: data/standards/iso/standards.seed.json, data/standards/asme/standards.seed.json (and the other 5 standards subdirectories, for completeness), each standard record's organization/designation/edition/title/standard_status fields
selected_t16_target.affected_consumers: data/projections/tapping/tapping-profiles.json's standards[] array directly; indirectly every product that renders a standard designation (Atlas, Workflow, Evidence, CSV)
selected_t16_target.exact_gap: No check compares the projection's standards[].organization/designation/edition/title/verification_state against the corresponding fields on the actual knowledge.standardById-resolved record.
selected_t16_target.not_already_covered_by: T13 (tap_drill.status), T14 (tap_drill.convention/provenance narrative), T15 (application_notes.source) -- all three closed different, already-named field families; this is standards identity, untouched by any of them.

forbidden_files: data/standards/**/*.json (except as a temporary, restored mutation fixture)
implementation_contract.validator_behavior_required: For every profile row's standards[] entry, look up knowledge.standardById.get(standard_id) and compare organization/designation/edition/title/verification_state (mapped to standard_status) field-by-field; fail on any mismatch.
implementation_contract.pass_criteria: 0 errors on real data (already confirmed 0 mismatches); correct failure on a reproduced mismatch; all other validators unaffected; every checksum outside the validator itself unchanged

mutation_test_contract.method: Temporarily edit one real standard record in data/standards/iso/standards.seed.json (e.g. iso_2306's designation or edition), backed up first, WITHOUT regenerating the projection.
mutation_test_contract.expected_result: FAIL, identifying the specific standard_id and mismatched field
mutation_test_contract.restoration: restore from backup, confirm byte-identical checksum, confirm validator returns to PASS

selected_t16_target.determinism_requirement: validator run 3x on restored real data, byte-identical report

implementation.check_added: Standards Denormalized Fields Match Authoritative Standard Record
implementation.mechanism: For every profile row's standards[] entry, resolves knowledge.standardById.get(standard_id) and compares organization/designation/edition/title/verification_state (mapped to source's standard_status) field-by-field against the projected values, failing on any mismatch with an error identifying the profile, designation, standard_id, field, authoritative value, and projected value.

mutation_failure.method: Temporarily edited the real data/standards/iso/standards.seed.json (backed up first), changing iso_2306's designation from 'ISO 2306' to 'ISO 2306-MUTATED-T16', WITHOUT regenerating the projection.
mutation_failure.note: One error per tapping profile referencing iso_2306 -- all three tapping datasets (metric_tapping/unc_tapping/unf_tapping) share iso_2306 in their source_standards, so it appears on all 29 rows.
mutation_failure.sample_error_message: tap_m3x0_5_cut (designation M3x0.5) standard 'iso_2306': designation mismatch -- authoritative value is 'ISO 2306-MUTATED-T16', projected value is 'ISO 2306'

restoration_pass.method: Restored data/standards/iso/standards.seed.json from the pre-mutation backup.
